question: _______ is the only State of India where the Sangai deer is found.
solution:
Correct answer is **__Manipur.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****

__
 
• The sangai, endemic to **Manipur**, is found only at the** Keibul Lamjao National Park (KLNP)**, the world's only floating national park.
 
• It is largely seen over the floating biomass, locally known as **“phumdi” in the South Eastern part of Loktak Lake inside the park. **
 
• The park covers an area of **40 km²** and the home range of the deer in the park is confined to **15–20 km².**
 
• Sangai, also known as the **brow-antlered deer or the dancing deer.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da2e056a7fa27b53670b998418fb380ceaa9103b871379019fd63185b58131f8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary** is the **biggest wildlife sanctuary in Kerala** which is Spread over an area of approximately** 777 sq km.**** **
 
• The **Kaziranga National Park** is a famous wildlife sanctuary in **Assam.**
 
• **Nauradehi Wildlife Sanctuary**, covering about **1,197 km****² **is the** largest wildlife sanctuary **in Madhya Pradesh state in India.
